title: unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-e2e-stability-guards
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: reduce release risk for model rollouts by adding end-to-end stability guards, tighten metric-driven auto-rollback thresholds, and add deterministic staging for canary/A-B/shadow experiments. This PR bundles runtime changes, rollout controller updates, new e2e tests, and observability improvements to make automated rollback decisions more robust under production traffic patterns. Scope: 1) rollout controller: add configurable composite-metric policies and cooldown windows, surface metric match confidence, and deterministic probing schedule for staged shadow+canary sequences; 2) runtime: add lightweight probing harness that can target model variants and collect latency/error quantiles under representative load without affecting user traffic; 3) e2e tests: deterministic integration tests that run staged shadow->canary->ab sequences and assert rollback triggers on synthetic regressions; 4) observability: new tracing spans and dashboard panels for rollout decision paths and metric-level explanations. Checklist: [x] controller impl, [x] probing harness, [x] e2e tests, [x] dashboards, [x] unit+integration tests, [x] docs update (rollouts.md). Rollback behavior: composite policy evaluates request-level correctness rate, latency p95, and model quality proxy (response score), applies safety gates (min-sample, cooldown, trend confirmation) before decision, and supports manual override. Related: ENG-2145 (autorollback reliability), ENG-2268 (stability testing harness), SUP-8721 incident follow-up. Impact: reduces false-positive rollbacks, improves time-to-detect real regressions, and gives SREs better diagnostics for rollout decisions.

Suggest adding a cooldown and a trend confirm window. - implemented cooldown window and trend confirmation parameters in policies.yaml and engine.go, unit+e2e tests added.

Sofia Martinez: Observability note: include raw sample counts and metric confidence in dashboard so oncall can inspect; also add trace link in alert payload. - added counts/tags to rollout.decision spans and dashboard panel, updated alert templates.
